fluff.title: Fluff
fluff.intro: Fluff, the Celestimal of Order is the unofficial leader of the cute team of Serafimz. Often the one to keep the gang in check and organize most of their activities. She was the first to appear in the comic.
fluff.personality: Fluff's personality revolves around order, seriousness, responsibility and peace. She also loves knowledge and desires to know how most things work and why. Among the Celestimals she is the most knowledgeable about the lore of the Cozy Realm. While being more grounded and behaving unlike the rest of the Celestimals she does love to play and will never turn down an opportunity for that.
fluff.appearance: Fluff resembles a polar fox. Her fluffy fur is mostly white save for the black ear tips, eyes and nose. Her eyelids and the area under her eyebrows are a shade of grey.
fluff.history: Once arriving to Cozy World Fluff was quick to learn about the nature of things around her. She was quick to discover the library in the Gnome Village and start borrowing books that sound fun. Her curiosity for knowledge did not stop at lore but got her to ponder the actions and decisions other Celestimals make. Beside knowledge she also has a running rivalry with Bun, though it's obviously of a playful sort.
fluff.trivia: She has a running gag with Bun involving pillow fights, with Bun often being the one to start it.
fluff.behindTheScenes: Fluff was inspired by a minor character/species from a Dungeon Village 2 game made by Kairsoft, called Tuff-Fluff. They are small fluffy and cute yet formidable fighters. This inspired the appearance and the serious nature of Fluff.

bun.title: Bun
bun.intro: Bun, the arbiter of mischief and adorableness, is the second Celestimal to appear in the comic. She is the source of rebellion and ambition among her friends. Often underestimated, she is quite capable of most things she puts her mind to. Despite the mischief she has a very endearing side.
bun.personality: When there is trouble, it's likely Bun started it, and it's always of a cute and funny sort. This bunny does not rest easy. She represents fun, ambition, mischief and friendship. Either you'll find her looking cute or stirring trouble. Two sides of the same Bun coin. Despite rebellious nature she is also very attached to her friends. She loves to help whenever help is needed. She also tends to play with Waffle a lot. Which is a recipe for chaos.
bun.appearance: Bun looks like a small pink bunny. She has white fluff around her neck and her eartips, whisker area, front paws and tail are white. Her eyes are blue while her nose is reddish/pink.
bun.history: After arriving to Cozy Realm she quickly found a mischief to start. Borrowing a pillow from Beardy's home she snuck up on Fluff and before the latter could ask what she is doing, she hit her with it. All that just so she could get Fluff to chase her back, something she likes a lot. She found fondness in Cozy Realm fruit and can be sometimes seen munching on it. She also likes visiting Mittens's bakery to watch him prepare tasty pastry, often bringing some back to her friends.
bun.trivia: Besides her running gag with Fluff involving pillow fights, she also has a big play with BatCake which is yet to be revealed.
bun.behindTheScenes: Originally designed as a character purely because little bunnies are adorable, and when you make them mischievous it takes things to the next level.

cake.title: Cake
cake.intro: Cake, a kitten Celestimal with no bounds of curiosity, is the wildcard of the gang. Very caring on one and very predestined for chaos on the other side. When unsupervised.
cake.personality: Cake is a simple kitten that is very curious, caring, creative and adventurous. To very notable degrees. No, seriously. If there is a disaster nearby, she is likely sitting closer. Unless Fluff ensures she is supervised. Besides curiosity, Cake loves keeping her friends safe and getting them all they need or desire. When bored she might borrow a random device from Tinkerhat to play with, or go on adventures and explore. She loves finding new things and new friends.
cake.appearance: Her appearance pretty much is that of a cute little yellow cat. Her whiskers area is white, along a ring on her tail, fluffy chest fur and all four paws. Her ears have a notable lynx like fluff on their tips. She has silly slit pupils.
cake.history: Once in Cozy Realm Cake was notably missing for a bit. That being the curious nature of her taking her to Gnome Village to explore. She was quick to find Tinkerhat's workshop and the place to borrow toys from in the future. And quickly enough she was already on his superbike speeding across The Meadows. She was the one to find Waffle's egg and discover the Big Dragon in the forest. Eventually her curiosity with fizz candy and soda caused a major detonation that covered the Gnome Village and the surrounding region in bubble foam, which was the first major disaster.
cake.trivia: Cake has an alter ego of BatCake, a super hero that solves mysteries and brings tasty snacks to her friends. She always pronounces word cake in a shortened form of 'cak', while her name despite the same she always pronounces properly.
cake.behindTheScenes: Cake is the first of the trio to be drawn and designed. A concept sketch was drawn depicting her purring and daydreaming about cake, happiness and sleeping.

waffle.title: Waffle
waffle.intro: It's a dinosaur! And a raptor Celestimal specifically. A cute little engine of curiosity and playful energy. Impossible to tame and irresistible to say no to.
waffle.personality: Mix curiosity, playfulness and desire to explore with shenanigans while adding extra amount of cuteness and you get Waffle. His spirit for curiosity matches that of Cake's while being focused on exploration and trying new things. His very determined nature gives Fluff some trouble to control, something she gets Cake to help with.
waffle.appearance: Waffle resembles a little green dinosaur. His frontal area is of lighter shade of green alongside his hands/claws. His claws on legs are white while the fluff along his arms and his tail fluff are red. His eyes are silly slit pupils.
waffle.history: Waffle arrived in the Cozy Realm mid-way the season 1. His egg was discovered by Cake who also kept it around the group before he appeared from it. Once he finally appeared Cake tossed a waffle at him which he took immediate liking for, something he also inherited his name from. Onward he would be shown many things and places by others, occasionally wandering off by himself to explore. Fluff also started to train him how to be a 'proper' raptor just like in the movies, which started to unlock his fierce nature.
waffle.trivia: He has a running gag of being the villainous raptor just like in the Jurassic Park franchise, which the Celestimals like to play pretend with.
waffle.behindTheScenes: Waffle is the true catalyst of this franchise. He predates all the other character designs and ideas, including the rest of the Celestimals. Originally, he and his personality were designed for an Android pet game centered around playing and spending time with him, exploring with him, giving him snacks, and more. Ultimately it was never made so his idea remained in the limbo until Smol Serafimz came into plan where he was scheduled to be a part of from the very beginning. Given his significance it was decided that he should be the anticipated arrival rather than being present in the very first comic.

beardy.title: Beardy
beardy.intro: The leader of the gnomes and the decision-maker in the Gnome Village, Beardy is very calm and grandfatherly, always eager to help. His calm demeanour allows him to tolerate the antics of the Serafimz with ease, and he is never quick to judge. His wisdom is immense, and he always seems to know best.
beardy.personality: Beardy is a calm and grandfatherly figure. His great wisdom ensures he always knows what is best for any occasion. He is never quick to judge and likes to see things from a broader point of view. He is quite perceptive and can predict outcomes by observing events as they unfold.
beardy.appearance: He sports the classic gnome cone hat, a blue sweater, and brown pants. He wears a light brown belt and shoes. He is always seen with his glasses.
beardy.history: Not much is known about the history of the gnomes, save that they moved into The Meadow from the depths of the Old Gnome Forest. With his kin, he established the Gnome Village in the upper region of The Meadow. Eventually, he came across the three Celestimal eggs and brought the news to the village. Given their shy nature, the gnomes decided to prepare a welcome cake but let the Celestimals establish themselves a bit before introducing themselves. He is seen witnessing the Fizz explosion event while tidying up the village and correctly deduces that Cake was likely responsible for it.
beardy.trivia: His house is a giant mushroom in the center of the village.
beardy.behindTheScenes: Inspirations for Beardy and gnomes in general came from The Smurfs franchise, with Papa Smurf serving as his counterpart. They share a red hat. Among the gnomes, however, a red hat is not a status symbol of leadership but merely a traditional gnome hat.

tinkerhat.title: Tinkerhat
tinkerhat.intro: The mechanic, inventor, and developer. The master of all tech trades. His curiosity knows no bounds, and he invents everything, even things that have no real practical use in the Cozy Realm. If there is a device somewhere, he made it. He loves getting feedback from everyone who uses his creations. His house is also his workshop. It might be cluttered during the day, but he loves putting everything back in its place in the evening.
tinkerhat.personality: He loves crafting things; it is his favourite pastime. Nobody knows where his knowledge of technology comes from, but he is very proficient in his craft. He may seem a bit less talkative than other gnomes, but that is mostly because he spends much of his time in his workshop rather than socialising. When he does talk, he is eager to fix anything or solve any problems others may have, even crafting new things that might be useful. Seeing his devices bring usefulness and fun to others is his primary desire.
tinkerhat.appearance: He wears a pointy red gnome hat with goggles on it, yellow clothes with brown overalls, brown shoes, and a tool belt. He has a wide, pointy black beard.
tinkerhat.history: He is first seen in his workshop repairing a fridge in the first episode. Every device seen in later episodes came from him, either borrowed by the Celestimals or given to them.
tinkerhat.trivia: Sometimes he might craft things that have no real purpose in the world, like bandages, coins, or weapons (with harm neither existing nor being possible in the reality of the Cozy Realm). This proves that he also makes non-technological items. Nevertheless, the Celestimals will always find ways to give them some purpose in their play.
tinkerhat.behindTheScenes: Given that the Cozy Realm is not a material reality, electricity is not a concept used in its technology. Instead, he was designed to use magic crystals that replace batteries and power his devices.

mittens.title: Mittens
mittens.intro: The gnome baker and the main food maker in the Gnome Village. He has a jolly personality and loves preparing baked goods for everyone. His pretzels are legendary among Cozy Realm inhabitants. He takes great pleasure in running his bakery.
mittens.personality: He is quite humorous and tends to find humour in all manner of things. He is eager to teach others how to prepare food.
mittens.appearance: He wears a chef's hat, a blue T-shirt, black pants, brown shoes, a white-and-gold apron with a cupcake image on it, and a pair of blue mittens. His beard is grey, medium-length, and curly, forming an arch from ear to ear. He also has a thin, stylish, curved black moustache.
mittens.history: He is first seen in the first episode preparing pizza. He is mentioned later by Bun in episode 23 for giving her a pretzel to share with her friends.
mittens.trivia:
He has gained a permanent number-one fan in Cake, as she adores his pretzels more than anyone else's, often yelling 'Pretzel!' whenever she sees one. He likes to occasionally surprise her with different kinds of pretzels.

His house can be seen on the map, where it is depicted as a shop with a sign panel above it.
mittens.behindTheScenes: Like the rest of the gnomes, he was designed to represent the happiness people find in tasty foods and confectionery. Pretzels are the artist's favourite pastry.

shrooms.title: Shrooms
shrooms.intro: The caretaker of all plant-based things in the Cozy Realm. The gardener of forests and a gnome wizard of all things green.
shrooms.personality: Shrooms is a very carefree gnome, always relaxed and never rushing into things. He loves nature, and some might say he tends to spend more time roaming outdoors than in the village. He likes to sit or lie down in the vast wilderness and listen to the wind and the rustling of the trees. He has a very calm and tranquil personality.
shrooms.appearance: He sports rather adventurous clothing. His hat is a yellow hybrid of a gnome hat and a straw hat. He wears grey khaki shorts with pockets, an orange T-shirt, a brown bandolier, and a pair of sandals. His beard style resembles a Uniform-Length Chin Curtain.
shrooms.history: His first appearance is in episode 26, where he is seen finishing sweeping leaves with Beardy near their homes. When the Fizz detonation took place and covered the village in pink bubble foam, he humorously called it 'The Fizz Season'.
shrooms.trivia: Given that the Cozy Realm is not a material world, plants are not living beings but part of the realm itself. Despite this, his interest in them is even greater, as it brings him closer to the source of all things.
shrooms.behindTheScenes: He was originally intended to look more like Gandalf, with a robe and hat. However, given the artist's adventurous spirit and history, he eventually adopted his current clothing style.
